_comment: Card SMX (docs/refound/SMX_scenario_matrix_2026-10-24.md): the standing fault-scenario matrix.
FROZEN 2026-10-24 before the first leg ran.  A change to a row, a channel, a factor or a floor is
a new version of this file, recorded in the card with the reason; it never moves a bar after a run.
_seed_snapshot_index: the 9th snapshot of the seed history (written every 1800 s from the first emitted epoch, so 4 h after the start on every posture); its n_emitted suffix differs by posture
sat_rule: G25, unless G25 is a GPS clock pivot (S line or a PIVOT event) at the snapshot epoch of a posture's seed; then G12

clk.what: wire satellite clock, event minus null, de-commoned per epoch and constellation (median), max over post-event epochs of the RMS over satellites

pb.what: wire phase bias, event minus null, de-commoned per epoch, constellation and signal (median), on (sat, signal) whose hold generation is the same in both legs; max over post-event epochs of the RMS

cons_peak.what: held-out consumer SZZ000SIM, max over post-event epochs of |p_event - p_null| (ENU error vectors)

cons_plat.what: held-out consumer, |mean over the last plateau_epochs of (p_event - p_null)|

zwd.what: station ZWD error growth against truth: max over stations and post-event epochs of |zwd_event - truth| - |zwd_null - truth|

iono.what: slant ionosphere iono_total_m, event minus null, de-commoned per station and epoch (median), max over lines of sight and post-event epochs

emit.what: post-event epochs the null emitted and the event leg did not (a withhold is an adaptation failure); bar 0

spread: S (the null's own spread) = the white-noise equivalent of the null leg's first differences over the post-event window, sqrt(mean(d^2)/2), of the same per-epoch quantity (the de-commoned null clock, phase bias, ZWD and slant ionosphere per entity, the consumer's ENU error vector); bar = max(factor * S, floor) + reference

plant_reference._source: card PLANT section 3.1 table A (S48000SIM, East): clock RMS 33.2 mm/m (hour 1), phase bias RMS 54.9 mm/m (hour 2), consumer median shift 3.40 mm/m (hour 2)

clk_truth.what: wire clock level against truth (scripts/simnet_clock_truth_grade.py), hour 2 rms, event fixture minus null fixture; S = the null's own hour-2 rms

cons_p50.what: consumer 3D p50 in hour 2, event fixture minus null fixture; S = the null consumer's hour-2 first-difference scatter

rows.what: slip, one signal, small (1 cycle, no LLI)
slip, one signal, large (100 cycles, no LLI)
slip on both signals of one satellite together (9 and 7 cycles: the geometry-free-blind pair)
slip storm: GPS slips on every station at the campaign rate (6.8 per station-hour), |delta| uniform 12 to 125 cycles, LLI with probability 0.506, elevation >= 15 deg, 240 epochs, schedule seed 1
single-signal loss of lock with return at the phase-anchor station of the satellite's L2W family (card L5B shape): L2W and its channels gone 2 epochs while L1C tracks, back with +3 cycles and LLI
whole-satellite outage at one station with return (20 epochs)
satellite clock step +0.5 m (the wire is expected to carry -0.5 m on that satellite; the expectation is subtracted)
receiver clock step of 1 ms (299792.458 m), the receiver clock-steering jump
phase-anchor handover, continuous, every family of the satellite
phase-anchor handover, cold, every family of the satellite
arc erase (the production RAIM attribution erase) on one healthy arc
broadcast health flip of the satellite for 10 epochs; read only by network.sat_health (posture gx); UNREAD on g, c and n
held coordinate of the station stepped 1 cm East (permanent)
satellite clock drift of the clock fixture (card SCB: offset 0.5 m, rate 1e-5 m/s, random walk 3e-8 m2/s), 2 h from 00:30:15 against the quiet fixture
